name: Austria

flag.description: Three equal horizontal stripes of red, white and red.
flag.symbolism: The colours come from the arms of the Babenberg dukes; legend says Duke Leopold V's white tunic was soaked in blood at the Siege of Acre in 1191, except under his belt.

hook: Picture a blood-soaked white tunic with a clean band where the belt was: Austria is bright red-white-red in equal stripes, unlike Latvia's dark maroon with a thin white stripe.
trivia: The red-white-red colours are attested as early as 1230, making them among the oldest national colours in the world.
The state flag used by government bodies adds Austria's coat of arms, a black eagle, in the centre.
